articles.title: Quad unveils maritime surveillance, military exercise amid China concerns
articles.description: Top Quad leaders announced new initiatives including a maritime surveillance system, military exercise, cable connectivity, and cybersecurity partnership to strengthen cooperation in the Indo-Pacific. They also opposed destabilising actions and economic coercion, reaffirming their commitment to a free and open region.

articles.description: INS Sahyadri joins JAIMEX 2026 with JMSDF, showcasing interoperability through coordinated maneuvers, drills, and cross-deck landings.

articles.title: Quad announces first-ever military exercise for 2027, sends political signal to China
articles.description: The Quad countries on Tuesday sent a political signal to China by announcing their first-ever military exercise, scheduled to be conducted in 2027. articles.title: Trump and Albanese to counter China with joint military exercise
articles.description: US President Donald Trump has announced joint naval activities with Australia, Japan and India after the first leader-level meeting of the Quad in more than two years.
